current.text: Mark Williams is out long term with a torn labrum, with an expected absence of 5 to 6 months.
Oso Ighodaro has started the last two games at center ahead of Maluach. Their minutes are similar.
Experts expect him to split center minutes with Ighodaro.
The newest call is that he is more of a stash and will struggle to reach 24 minutes a game.
He averaged 18 points, 13 rebounds, 2 blocks and 2 threes in summer league and was a top 10 fantasy player there.
He is a late flyer worth a pick around 120 to 125. Do not take him inside the top 100.
If he wins the starting job, he has top 75 upside.

durable.text: He is a big man who brings rebounds, shot blocking and a good FG%, and he can stretch the floor. Experts call him a strong defender and expect him to be an okay free throw shooter.
He turned 31.5% of his rim contests into blocks.
Blocks are his standout category. They are far above the top 250 pool.
His steals are very low, even for a center, and his assists are low for his position.

note: Yahoo values him at 2 USD (rank 113) and ESPN at 0 USD (rank 202), so in our 144-player draft he is a 1 to 2 USD last-round flyer for blocks. He fits punt STL and punt AST builds that need blocks and rebounds. In the first weeks, check whether he or Ighodaro starts at center and whether his minutes reach the mid 20s. If Ighodaro keeps the job, Maluach is a cut or waiver-level stash.
